arguments.query: select name,sql from sqlite_master where name in ("bookings","charges","outbox")

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,(select group_concat(c.charge_id||":"||c.idempotency_key||":"||c.state||":"||c.amount_cents) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b where b.status="pending"

select (select count(*) from charges where state="captured") cap,(select count(*) from charges where state<>"captured") noncap,(select count(*) from holds) holds,(select count(*) from outbox where status<>"delivered") ob,(select count(*) from (select booking_id from charges where state="captured" group by 1 having count(*)>1)) dup,(select count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id)) nohold,(select count(*) from bookings where client_reference is not null) cr,(select count(*) from (select client_reference from bookings where status="confirmed" and client_reference is not null group by 1 having count(*)>1)) dupsale

select b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.passenger_id,b.amount_cents,b.client_reference,b.confirmed_at,(select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k from bookings b where client_reference is not null
